# Apple

> > Apple designs and develops consumer electronics, software, and services including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and platforms like iOS, iPadOS, and Apple Intelligence.

Apple's ecosystem spans hardware products (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple TV), operating systems (iOS, iPadOS, macOS), and services (iCloud+, Apple Pay, Apple Arcade, Apple Music, App Store). The company emphasizes innovation, accessibility, privacy, and integration across devices with features like Siri, Apple Intelligence, Find My, and FaceTime.

## Key Topics

- iPhone
- iPad
- Mac
- Apple Watch

## Core Products & Services

- [Apple Pay - Apple](https://www.apple.com/apple-pay): Mobile payment service for iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac & iPad
- [iCloud+ - Apple](https://www.apple.com/icloud): Cloud storage subscription with photo backup, privacy & family sharing
- [iOS - CarPlay - Apple](https://www.apple.com/ios/carplay): iPhone integration for cars with Apple Maps, Siri & digital car keys
- [Apple Arcade - Apple](https://www.apple.com/apple-arcade): Gaming subscription for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV 4K & Mac with no ads
- [Final Cut Pro - Apple](https://www.apple.com/final-cut-pro): Professional video editing software for Mac & iPad with AI features
- [AirPods Pro 3 - Hearing Health - Apple](https://www.apple.com/airpods-pro/hearing-health): AirPods Pro 3 hearing health features with hearing test & aid support
- [Apple Watch For Your Kids - Apple](https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-for-your-kids): Apple Watch family setup with cellular, location tracking & safety features

## Business & Enterprise

- [Enterprise - Business - Apple](https://www.apple.com/business/enterprise): Enterprise IT solutions with device management & security for business
- [Apple Shared Values: Teams and Impact - Careers at Apple](https://www.apple.com/careers/us/life-at-apple/shared-values.html): Employee stories showcasing Apple's culture, values & global impact

## Technical Specifications

- [iPad mini - Technical Specifications - Apple](https://www.apple.com/ipad-mini/specs): Technical specs for iPad mini with A17 Pro chip & Liquid Retina display
- [Apple TV 4K - Technical Specifications - Apple](https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-4k/specs): Technical specs for Apple TV 4K with A15 Bionic & HDMI 2.1
- [HomePod (2nd generation) - Technical Specifications - Apple](https://www.apple.com/homepod-2nd-generation/specs): Technical specs for HomePod 2nd gen with Dolby Atmos & Siri
